description: No mechanism exists for data subjects to obtain rectification of inaccurate personal data or completion of incomplete data without undue delay.
applicability: Applicable to all personal data storage systems. Must enable correction of inaccuracies and completion of incomplete records upon request.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of data correction procedures and self-service capabilities. Verify ability to update personal data across all systems.

sources.title: GDPR - Regulation (EU) 2016/679
sources.section: Chapter III - Rights of the Data Subject

sources.title: EDPB Guidelines on Data Subject Rights
